footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Rayonier: includes $406M from discontinued operations; after $6.0M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 51.0% to $484M in 2025. Gross margin was 32.5%, versus 44.6% a year earlier, and operating income fell 77.1% to $83.3M, a 17.2% margin.
Net income rose 32.1% to $474M, or $3.03 per share. Operating cash flow was $257M and free cash flow $257M, versus $177M; Rayonier returned $295M through dividends and buybacks.
sources: Rayonier Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
